title: client-integration-triage-sprint-checklist-2028-06-18
notes:
Meeting: Solutions Eng + ProServices weekly triage
Date: 2028-06-18 10:00 PT (recording in Slack thread)
Attendees: Maya Chen (owner), Diego Alvarez, Priya Nambiar, Samir Patel, Jordan Lee, Evelyn Park, +1 customer success (Kenji)
Purpose: quick health check across active integrations, surface escalations, agree on next-step owners for customer-facing deliverables.

Quick summary: short, sharp updates. Two customers progressing on schedule (Novacore, Brightline), one customer (Kestrel Health) has a production blocker relating to VPC egress policies and requires networking team pairing, and one pilot (Arcadia Retail) is slipping due to dataset access delays. We agreed an immediate triage for Kestrel and a contingency MTL (model-to-local) plan if Arcadia data isn't available by 6/25.

Customer-by-customer notes:
1) Novacore - green
- Status: ontrack for soft launch (7/02).
- This sprint: final acceptance tests (latency SLA test, load at 200rps) scheduled 6/21.
- Dependencies: Dedicated capacity reservation confirmed (pool-c-02). Load test scripts in repo: infra/qa/novacore-load.
- Action items: Diego to run pre-cutover smoke at 6/21 8:00 PT and post results to PR. Samir to validate telemetry tags (customer_id/route) before canary.
- Risks: low. If load test shows sustained 95th > 220ms we will temporarily bump instance type and rerun.

2) Brightline - amber (feature gating and auth)
- Status: feature flags in staging; final auth handshake with customer SSO provider flakey on token rotation.
- Blocker: SSO token TTL mismatch; sometimes refresh fails and returns 401. Repro steps captured in ticket JIRA-7432.
- Action items: Priya to coordinate with customer SRE and rotate test credentials 6/19. Jordan to add retry-on-401 shim in auth proxy (PR drafted).
- Notes: customer asked for a postmortem template if issue repeats during cutover window. Evelyn to prepare template.

3) Kestrel Health - red (production blocker)
- Status: customer cannot reach private inference endpoint from their VPC due to egress firewall rules. Requests time out; handshake doesn't complete.
- Troubleshooting done so far: verified routing table, confirmed endpoint IPs from control plane, tested curl from bastion (timed out).
- Hypothesis: outbound policy restricts egress to specific ASN ranges; our endpoint falls outside.
- Immediate plan: escalate to Network Ops for full firewall rule audit and request temporary allowlist.
- Action items: Maya to open escalation with Network Ops (ticket NETOPS-1296) and copy customer SRE; Samir to provide a sanitized list of endpoint CIDRs and ports; Diego to coordinate a midday pairing session 6/18 15:00 PT with Kestrel SRE.
- Contingency: if we cannot get egress policy changed by 6/20, propose Private deployment (on-prem package) trial with Kestrel for limited beta. Note this will require legal review; flagged for Legal/CS sync.

4) Arcadia Retail (pilot) - sliding to amber
- Status: scheduled dataset handoff delayed by customer (data deidentification still in progress).
- Impact: training of reranker and evaluation harness blocked; evaluation expected to shift by one sprint.
- Action items: Jordan to prepare a synthetic dataset template so we can run early pipeline validation without PII; Priya to set a hard follow-up date with the customer (6/22).
- Note to self: confirm whether synthetic runs will affect performance baselines; tag these runs as 'synthetic' in Console for later filtering.

Cross-customer themes and operational notes:
- Model pinning: we discovered two customers still referencing the ephemeral tag 'latest-llama-compat' in their configs. Samir/Platform to send out a recommended pinning checklist and a short script to convert tags to explicit versions. Action: Samir by 6/20.
- Telemetry: request to add a per-request header echo (x-rw-customer-env) to make post-hoc tracing simpler. Diego to champion with runtime team; prototyping target week of 6/24.
- Rollouts: remind teams to use canary percentage step-ups (10% -> 30% -> 60%) for any model change that touches production routes. We saw a surprise regression last month when a 0->100 rollout happened.
- Cost/throughput note: Dedicated pool autoscaler misfired during Friday's maintenance simulation; scaling cooldown incorrectly set to 30m. Filed infra PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/981) to make cooldown configurable per pool.

Open action list (owner / due date):
- Diego: run Novacore load smoke, upload artifacts to the PR (due 2028-06-21).
- Samir: telemetry tag validation + pinning script (due 2028-06-20).
- Priya: coordinate Brightline token rotation with customer SRE, confirm 6/19 call (due 2028-06-19).
- Jordan: implement auth retry shim and synthetic dataset template (PR + doc due 2028-06-22).
- Maya: escalate Kestrel to Network Ops and setup pairing session (NETOPS-1296) (due 2028-06-18 EOD).
- Evelyn: postmortem template for Brightline (due 2028-06-21).
- Legal/CS: prepare fast-track review for Private trial (Maya to request) (target 2028-06-23).

Blockers & escalation summary:
- Kestrel network egress — high priority escalation to Network Ops (owner: Maya).
- Brightline SSO token mismatch — medium priority, customer SRE pairing (owner: Priya).
- Arcadia data handoff — low-medium; mitigations in place using synthetic data (owner: Jordan).

Meeting follow-ups and next meeting:
- Follow-up notes: capture results of Novacore load test and Kestrel pairing session in this doc thread. Add a short summary for CS readiness channel.
- Next sync: 2028-06-25 10:00 PT (weekly cadence). If any high-severity block pops up, we will call an ad-hoc triage.

Notes to self / rough ideas (informal):
- Look into a small 'egress-check' diagnostic script that customers can run from their side to proactively confirm our endpoint reachability (could be shipped as a tiny shell+curl snippet in onboarding kit).
- Consider adding a health-check page for Dedicated pools that shows IP ranges and region mappings (helpful for networking teams).
- Keep the synthetic dataset templates minimal but realistic — include token distributions and a few edge-case examples.
